title: Unit 6
text: Good morning, everyone. Today I'll talk about different ways to take care of the Earth.
Do you know Earth Hour? It's on ________________.
My friends and I will do many other things to take care of the Earth. We'll ________________.
What else will you do to take care of the Earth? Discuss with your partner.
